[[Speak with Headmaster Vhang (Elementalist)]] | followed by = [[Spark of Interest]] | profession = Elementalist | primary = y | secondary = n }} Sends new Canthan Elementalists towards their new instructor. ==Quest information== ===Requirements=== {{ Standard prerequisites | campaign = factions | profession = Elementalist | primary = y | secondary = n }} ===Objectives=== * Search [[Sunqua Vale]] for [[Ronsu]]. ===Early benefits=== * Headmaster Vhang teaches you the following skills upon accepting the quest: ** {{skill icon|Aura of Restoration}} ** {{skill icon|Flare}} ** {{skill icon|Lightning Orb}} ===Reward=== * 100 [[Experience]] * 10 [[Gold]] ==Walkthrough== Ronsu can be found in the southern parts of Sunqua Vale, not far from the water. ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Headmaster Vhang ''"My powers are quite over your head, I am afraid. You should search [[Sunqua Vale]] and find my underling, [[Ronsu]]. He is the perfect choice to begin your training in the elemental arts, since his skill is minimal, at best.'' {{ Offer dialog | accept = I will look for Ronsu."'' | decline = I have something else to do, first."'' | ask = Can you not find [[Ronsu]]? I tell you, he waits in [[Sunqua Vale]]! Be gone. }} ===Reward dialogue=== ;Ronsu ''"So "Headmaster" Vhang sent you, eh? Well, you are quite lucky that he did. He is hardly the Elementalist he would like us all to think he is. If he could fight half as well as he speaks, perhaps he would deserve his title. Well, enough about Vhang. This is about you, now. I am Ronsu, and you are here to learn. What do you say we get started?"''
